name: Aashirvaad Whole Wheat Atta
description: Whole wheat flour for soft everyday rotis and parathas. Transfer to an airtight container once opened and keep in a cool, dry place.

name: Pillsbury Whole Wheat Atta
description: Chakki-ground whole wheat flour for rotis, phulkas and puris. Knead with lukewarm water for softer dough and store sealed away from moisture.

name: Aashirvaad Sharbati Atta
description: Atta milled from sharbati wheat, a grain variety grown mainly in Madhya Pradesh, used for rotis and parathas. Keep the pack sealed and dry.

name: Pillsbury Specialty Wheat Flour
description: Specialty-grade wheat flour for everyday rotis and parathas. Sift before kneading if you like, and store in an airtight tin after opening.

name: Aashirvaad Multigrain Atta
description: Wheat flour blended with other grains and millets for rotis with a slightly nutty taste. Store in a cool, dry place and use within the date on the pack.

name: Pillsbury Multigrain Atta
description: A wheat and millet flour mix for rotis, theplas and parathas. The dough may need a little more water than plain atta; keep the pack tightly closed.

name: Daawat Sona Masoori Rice
description: Light, medium-grain Sona Masoori rice suited to daily meals, pongal and lemon rice. Rinse before cooking and store in a covered container.

name: Fortune Sona Masoori Rice
description: Medium-grain Sona Masoori rice that cooks soft and separate for everyday rice with sambar or rasam. Keep dry and away from pantry pests.

name: HMT Rice
description: Loose raw HMT rice, a fine short-grain variety popular in central and south India for daily meals. Wash well before cooking and store in a sealed bin.

name: HMT Steam Rice
description: Steam-processed HMT rice that keeps grains firm and separate after cooking. Good for plain rice, khichdi and fried rice; store dry in a closed container.

name: bb Royal Kolam Rice
description: Short, slender kolam rice that cooks soft, a staple in Maharashtra and Gujarat for dal-chawal. Rinse two or three times and store in an airtight bin.

name: Double Horse Ponni Rice
description: Ponni rice from Tamil Nadu, a medium-grain variety used for daily meals, curd rice and variety rice. Store in a cool, dry place after opening.

name: Telangana Fine Rice
description: Loose fine-grain white rice from Telangana mills for everyday cooking. Soak for 15 minutes before cooking for even grains and keep in a sealed container.

name: White Rice
description: Graded loose white rice for daily use with dal, curry and sambar. Rinse until the water runs clear and store away from moisture.

name: India Gate Basmati Rice
description: Long-grain aged basmati rice with a natural aroma, suited to pulao, biryani and jeera rice. Soak for 20-30 minutes before cooking.

name: Daawat Basmati Rice
description: Fragrant long-grain basmati rice for biryani, pulao and everyday steamed rice. Rinse gently to keep the grains intact and store in an airtight jar.

name: India Gate Brown Rice
description: Brown basmati rice with the bran layer intact, giving a chewier bite. Soak for at least 30 minutes and cook with a little extra water.

name: Daawat Brown Rice
description: Whole-grain brown basmati rice for pulao, rice bowls and salads. Takes longer to cook than white rice; keep sealed in a cool place.

name: Double Horse Idli Rice
description: Parboiled short-grain rice for grinding idli and dosa batter with urad dal. Soak four to six hours before grinding and store the pack dry.

name: bb Royal Idli Rice
description: Idli rice for soft, fluffy idlis and crisp dosas. Combine roughly four parts rice to one part urad dal, soak and grind; keep the rest airtight.

name: 24 Mantra Organic Red Rice
description: Organic red rice with a reddish bran and earthy flavour, eaten with curries in Kerala and coastal Karnataka. Soak before cooking; cooks a little firmer.

name: Organic Tattva Black Rice
description: Organic black rice that turns deep purple when cooked, used for kheer, salads and rice bowls. Soak for a few hours and store in an airtight jar.

name: Tata Sampann Toor Dal
description: Unpolished split pigeon peas for everyday dal, sambar and dal fry. Rinse and pressure-cook until soft; store in a dry, airtight container.

name: Fortune Toor Dal
description: Split pigeon peas that cook to a creamy dal for rice and rotis. Soak for 20 minutes to shorten cooking time and keep the pack sealed.

name: Tata Sampann Moong Dal
description: Split yellow moong lentils that cook quickly for dal, khichdi and halwa. No long soaking needed; store in a cool, dry place.

name: Fortune Moong Dal
description: Split moong dal for light everyday dal, khichdi and cheela batter. Rinse well before use and keep in an airtight jar after opening.

name: Tata Sampann Masoor Dal
description: Split red lentils that turn golden and soft within minutes, ideal for quick dal and soups. Store away from moisture in a closed container.

name: Fortune Masoor Dal
description: Red split lentils for everyday dal tadka, soups and Bengali-style masoor dal. Cooks without soaking; keep the pack tightly closed.

name: Tata Sampann Urad Dal
description: Split white urad dal for idli and dosa batter, vadas and tempering. Soak before grinding and store in an airtight container.

name: Fortune Urad Dal
description: Urad dal for batters, medu vada and dal makhani-style dishes. Rinse well, soak as the recipe needs and keep the rest dry and sealed.

name: Tata Sampann Chana Dal
description: Split Bengal gram for chana dal, dal vada and sweets like puran poli. Soak for an hour to cut cooking time; store dry.

name: Fortune Chana Dal
description: Split Bengal gram for thick dals, kootu and tempering in South Indian cooking. Keep in an airtight jar away from humidity.

name: Horse Gram
description: Loose whole horse gram (kulthi), a hardy pulse used in rasam, soups and sprouts in South India. Soak overnight before pressure-cooking.

name: Cowpea
description: Loose whole cowpeas for curries, usal and salads. Soak for six to eight hours, then pressure-cook until tender; store in a dry jar.

name: Moth Beans
description: Small brown moth beans (matki) for sprouting, misal and dry sabzi. Soak overnight and keep sprouts refrigerated for up to two days.

name: Fortune Besan
description: Fine gram flour for pakoras, kadhi, cheela and laddoos. Sift before use for a smooth batter and store in an airtight container.

name: Aashirvaad Besan
description: Gram flour made from chana dal for bhajjis, dhokla, kadhi and sweets. Keep sealed and away from moisture to prevent lumps.

name: Aashirvaad Sooji
description: Wheat semolina for upma, rava idli, halwa and crisp coatings. Dry-roast before use for better flavour and keep in a closed jar.

name: Fortune Sooji
description: Semolina for upma, sheera, rava dosa and cakes. Store in an airtight container; roasting it lightly helps it keep longer.

name: Aashirvaad Maida
description: Refined wheat flour for naan, bhatura, samosa pastry and baking. Store in a dry, airtight container away from strong odours.

name: Fortune Maida
description: All-purpose refined flour for cakes, cookies, parathas and fried snacks. Sift before baking and keep the pack tightly sealed.

name: Double Horse Rice Flour
description: Fine rice flour for appam, idiyappam, pathiri and crisp murukku. Store in an airtight jar and use within the date on the pack.

name: MTR Rice Flour
description: Rice flour for akki roti, murukku, dosa batter and as a crisp coating for fries. Keep dry and sealed after opening.

name: Weikfield Corn Flour
description: Corn starch for thickening soups and gravies and for crisp coatings on Indo-Chinese starters. Mix with cold water before adding to hot liquids.

name: Brown & Polson Corn Flour
description: Fine corn starch for custards, sauces, soups and batters. Stir into cold liquid first to avoid lumps; store in a dry place.

name: Tata Sampann Rajma
description: Red kidney beans for rajma chawal and bean salads. Soak overnight and pressure-cook until fully soft before adding to gravies.

name: Fortune Rajma
description: Kidney beans for slow-cooked Punjabi rajma and wraps. Always soak and boil thoroughly; store the dry beans in an airtight jar.

name: Tata Sampann Kabuli Chana
description: White chickpeas for chole, chana masala, hummus and salads. Soak overnight and pressure-cook with a pinch of salt.

name: Fortune Kabuli Chana
description: Large white chickpeas for chole bhature, sundal and hummus. Soak eight hours before cooking and keep the pack sealed.

name: Tata Sampann Kala Chana
description: Brown chickpeas for kala chana curry, sundal and chaat. Soak overnight; they also sprout well in a day or two.

name: Fortune Kala Chana
description: Desi brown chickpeas for dry chana, curries and Navratri prasad. Soak well before pressure-cooking and store dry.

name: 24 Mantra Organic Lobia
description: Organic black-eyed peas for lobia masala, salads and stews. Soak for four to six hours and cook until tender.

name: bb Royal Lobia
description: Black-eyed peas that cook relatively quickly, for curries, usal and salads. Store in an airtight jar away from moisture.

name: bb Royal White Peas
description: Dried white peas (safed vatana) for ragda, ghugni and matar usal. Soak overnight and pressure-cook until soft.

name: Nutrela Soya Chunks
description: Dried soya chunks for curries, pulao and dry fry. Soak in hot water for 10 minutes, squeeze out the water and cook as needed.

name: Fortune Soya Chunks
description: Soya chunks made from defatted soy flour for gravies and biryani. Rehydrate in hot salted water before use and keep the pack dry.

name: Manna Ragi
description: Whole finger millet for porridge, sprouting and home-milled ragi flour. Rinse and dry before grinding; store in an airtight jar.

name: 24 Mantra Organic Jowar
description: Organic whole sorghum grains for khichdi, salads and pilaf-style dishes. Soak overnight and cook until tender.

name: Manna Ragi Flour
description: Finger millet flour for ragi mudde, rotis, dosas and porridge. Knead with hot water for softer rotis and store sealed.

name: 24 Mantra Organic Bajra Flour
description: Organic pearl millet flour for bajra rotla and thepla, popular in winter. Use fresh dough and keep the flour in the fridge in warm months.

name: Makki Atta
description: Loose yellow maize flour for makki ki roti with sarson ka saag. Knead with warm water just before rolling; keep in a cool, dry place.

name: Kuttu Atta
description: Loose buckwheat flour used for puris and pakoras during Navratri fasts. Bind with mashed potato for easier rolling and store airtight.

name: Singhara Atta
description: Loose water chestnut flour for vrat puris, halwa and pakoras. It absorbs water quickly, so add liquid gradually; store in an airtight jar.

name: Manna Multimillet Mix
description: A blend of millet flours for dosas, rotis and porridge. Follow the pack directions for batter consistency and refrigerate any leftover batter.

name: Tata Soulfull Multimillet Mix
description: Mixed millet flour for quick dosas, idlis and rotis. Store in a cool, dry place and close the pack tightly after each use.

name: 24 Mantra Organic Whole Wheat Atta
description: Certified organic whole wheat flour for rotis, puris and parathas. Keep the pack sealed in a cool, dry place to retain freshness.

name: Organic Tattva Whole Wheat Atta
description: Organic whole wheat flour for everyday rotis and baking at home. Transfer to an airtight tin after opening and use within the date on pack.

name: 24 Mantra Organic Sona Masoori Rice
description: Certified organic Sona Masoori rice for daily meals and South Indian rice dishes. Rinse before cooking and store in a closed container.

name: Organic Tattva Basmati Rice
description: Organic long-grain basmati rice for pulao, biryani and jeera rice. Soak for 30 minutes before cooking for longer grains.

name: 24 Mantra Organic Toor Dal
description: Certified organic split pigeon peas for dal, sambar and khichdi. Rinse and pressure-cook; store in an airtight container.

name: Organic Tattva Moong Dal
description: Organic split moong dal that cooks quickly for dal, khichdi and soups. Keep in a sealed jar away from humidity.

name: 24 Mantra Organic Ragi
description: Certified organic whole finger millet for porridge, malt and home-ground flour. Store in an airtight jar in a cool place.

name: Organic Tattva Quinoa
description: Organic quinoa for salads, upma and pulao-style dishes. Rinse well before cooking to remove the bitter coating; cooks in about 15 minutes.

name: Tata Sampann Poha
description: Flattened rice for kanda poha, chivda and quick breakfasts. Rinse briefly in a sieve and let it soften for a few minutes before cooking.

name: 24 Mantra Organic Poha
description: Organic rice flakes for poha, aval upma and snacks. Wash lightly, drain and rest before tempering; store in an airtight jar.

name: Tata Sampann Daliya
description: Broken wheat for savoury daliya khichdi, upma and sweet porridge. Dry-roast before cooking for a nuttier taste and store sealed.

name: Rajdhani Daliya
description: Coarse broken wheat for porridge, khichdi and lapsi. Pressure-cook with water or milk and keep the pack dry after opening.

name: Rajdhani Sabudana
description: Tapioca pearls for sabudana khichdi, vada and kheer during fasts. Soak for four to six hours until the pearls soften but stay separate.

name: Tata Sampann Sabudana
description: Sago pearls for khichdi, payasam and crisp vadas. Rinse before soaking and store the dry pearls in an airtight container.

name: Haldiram's Murmura
description: Puffed rice for bhel puri, jhal muri and chivda. Keep the pack tightly closed so it stays crisp; warm briefly in a pan if it softens.

name: Manna Ragi Flakes
description: Flakes made from finger millet for a quick poha-style breakfast or with milk. Rinse briefly before tempering; store airtight.

name: 24 Mantra Organic Red Poha
description: Organic red rice flakes for poha, aval upma and sweet aval. Soak a little longer than white poha and keep the pack sealed.

name: Organic Tattva Sabja Seeds
description: Sweet basil seeds that swell in water, used in falooda, nimbu pani and sherbets. Soak for 15 minutes before adding to drinks.

name: 24 Mantra Organic Sabja Seeds
description: Organic sabja seeds for falooda, lemonade and rose milk. Soak in water until they turn jelly-like and store the dry seeds sealed.

name: Rajdhani Sattu
description: Roasted gram flour for sattu sherbet, litti stuffing and parathas. Whisk with cold water, lemon and salt for a quick summer drink.

name: Patanjali Sattu
description: Sattu made from roasted chana for drinks, litti chokha and stuffed rotis. Store in an airtight jar in a cool place.

name: Manna Ragi Drink Mix
description: Ragi-based powder to stir into milk or water for a warm or chilled drink. Follow the pack ratio and keep the container tightly closed.

name: Slurrp Farm Ragi Drink Mix
description: A millet drink base made with ragi to mix into milk, hot or cold. Use a dry spoon and close the pack well after each use.

name: Haldiram's Roasted Chana
description: Crunchy roasted Bengal gram to snack on or grind into sattu and chutneys. Keep the pack sealed so it stays crisp.

name: 24 Mantra Organic Jaggery Powder
description: Organic powdered jaggery that dissolves easily in panakam, aam panna and sherbets. Store in an airtight jar to prevent clumping.

name: Organic Tattva Jaggery Powder
description: Powdered organic jaggery for summer coolers, chai and sweets. Use a dry spoon and keep the pack closed in humid weather.
